title: Yu Kappa Construction
body_html:
Yu Kappa Construction

Given a good factorization, one constructs representations \(\kappa^i\) of the groups \(K^i\) inductively. Start with \(\kappa^0=\phi\). At step \(i\), pull back the finite Weil representation through the special isomorphism attached to \((G^{i-1},G^i,\Gamma_{i-1})\), twist by the remaining central character, and descend the tensor product from \(K^{i-1}\ltimes J^i\) to \(K^i=K^{i-1}J^i\).

The final \(\kappa=\kappa^d\) is the positive-depth Heisenberg-Weil factor in the type \(\eta_\Sigma=\rho\otimes\kappa\).
